title: Boundary on translated forms: Y(d(γ(t + ·))) = X(γ(t + ·)) when ∂Y = X
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) and X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ) with Y.boundary = X, let γ be a test m-form on ℝ^P (IsTestForm γ) and t ∈ ℝ^P. Then currentEval Y (y ↦ dγ(t + y)) = currentEval X (y ↦ γ(t + y)), where dγ = exteriorDerivative γ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (t : Euclid P), Y.boundary = X → IsTestForm γ → currentEval Y (fun y => exteriorDerivative γ (t + y)) = currentEval X (fun y => γ (t + y))
